meta_description: Heating and Plumbing Newcastle offers expert gas engineering, boiler installs, and central heating across Newcastle upon Tyne. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Newcastle Upon Tyne
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns and heating problems sorted fast — keeping Newcastle homes warm when it matters most.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, we cover every aspect of gas engineering and plumbing for Newcastle homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Boiler Repair
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, getting your heating back up and running with minimal disruption. We carry common parts on the van so most repairs are completed in a single visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Supply and fit of energy-efficient A-rated boilers from leading brands, tailored to your home's heating demands. We handle everything from removal of the old unit through to full commissioning and handover.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full design and installation of central heating systems for new builds and older properties throughout Newcastle. Properly sized radiators, quality pipework, and a thorough pressure test included as standard.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlord Gas Safety Records (CP12) and homeowner safety inspections carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer. Certificates issued on the day, keeping you fully compliant with UK gas safety regulations.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler services that extend the life of your appliance, maintain manufacturer warranties, and keep running costs down. A thorough check of all components, flue, and pressure settings every time.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Leaking pipes, dripping taps, faulty radiator valves, and general plumbing faults tackled quickly across Newcastle upon Tyne. No job is too small — reliable, tidy workmanship every time.

about_pullquote: Every job done right — whether it's a washer or a full boiler install.
about_para_1: Heating and Plumbing is a Newcastle-based gas engineering and plumbing company serving homeowners, landlords, and tenants across the city. Operating from our base on St Ann's Close in NE1, we have built a steady reputation for prompt, honest, and affordable work across all aspects of domestic gas and plumbing. Our engineer is fully Gas Safe registered, so you can book with complete confidence.
about_para_2: What keeps customers coming back is straightforward: we turn up when we say we will, we explain clearly what needs doing and why, and we charge fairly for the work. We take pride in leaving every home as clean as we found it, and we never recommend work that isn't genuinely needed. That approach has made us a trusted name across Newcastle upon Tyne.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on one of the coldest nights of the year and these lads were out first thing the next morning. Fixed within the hour, fair price, and the engineer was dead friendly. Would absolutely recommend to anyone in Newcastle.
reviews.author: James P.

reviews.text: Had a full boiler replacement done last autumn. From the quote to the finished job the whole experience was easy and stress-free. Turned up on time, kept everything tidy, and took the old unit away without any fuss. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Karen D.

reviews.text: Needed a landlord gas safety certificate sorting quickly for a new tenant moving in. Got booked in the same week, certificate emailed over the same day. Efficient, professional, and good value. Will be using them every year.
reviews.author: Mark T.
